title: MT EUV · Rendern (mit Neustart bei Absturz)

steps.label: render 1-1588
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b euv.blend -P euv_render.py -- render 1 1588 100 >> rall.log 2>&1; n=$(ls r | wc -l); echo "pass $i frames $n"; [ $n -ge 1588 ] && break; sleep 5; done; grep -a '^FRAME' rall.log | tail -2; ls r | wc -l
